title: Foundation: interfaces, types, and registries
description:
Implement foundational types and registries from docs/plans/01-ai-core.add03.md.

Sections: 3.1, 3.2, 3.2.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 3.9

Key deliverables:
- APIClient interface (api_client.go) — §3.1
- API client registry (api_client_registry.go) — §3.2
- EmbeddingAPIClient interface (embedding_api_client.go) — §3.11
- Embedding API client registry (embedding_api_client_registry.go) — §3.2.1
- ProviderConfig struct, ProviderEndpoint struct, directAPIKeys map (provider.go) — §3.3
- Provider config registry with deep copy (provider_registry.go) — §3.4
- ResolveEndpoint helper (resolve.go) — §3.5
- Model struct changes: remove BaseURL, add PricingKnown, Headers to map[string][]string (models.go) — §3.6
- EmbeddingModel struct changes: remove BaseURL, add PricingKnown, Headers to map[string][]string (embedding.go) — §3.11
- CustomProviderConfig, RegisterCustomProvider, RegisterCustomModel (custom_provider.go) — §3.9
- StreamOptions.Headers type change to map[string][]string, BuildBaseOptions apiKey param removal (options.go) — §3.5
- deepCopyModel and deepCopyEmbeddingModel updates for map[string][]string Headers
- Unit tests for all registries (concurrent access, deep copy isolation)
- Unit tests for ResolveEndpoint (key resolution order, header merging, env vars)
- Unit tests for CustomProvider (validation, registration, overwrite)
- Unit tests for PricingKnown behavior

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/01-ai-core.add03.md §3.1-3.6, §3.9, §3.11, §5.2
- Test list: TestAPIClientRegistry, TestEmbeddingAPIClientRegistry, TestProviderConfigRegistry, TestResolveEndpoint, TestResolveEndpointEnvVars, TestCustomProviderRegistration, TestCustomProviderOverwritesCatalogProvider, TestCustomModelRegistration, TestCustomModelPricingKnown, TestCalculateCostPricingKnown
